title: Name Tag & Saddle Recipes
description: Backports the Name Tag & Saddle recipes from future versions of the game
body:
Simply adds the vanilla recipes for the Name Tag & Saddle from future minecraft versions to 1.21.1.

Name Tags can be crafted with 1 paper and either an Iron or Gold nugget.

Saddles can be crafted with 3 leather and 1 iron ingot.

Compatible with JEI.
